component.name: Tsuki
component.summary: Native Linux Game Launcher for Wine and Proton

description.p: Tsuki is a native Linux game launcher designed for Wine, Proton, and native titles. It provides seamless prefix management, Wine and Proton runner downloads, Winetricks integration, SteamGridDB artwork fetching, and virtual Xbox controller emulation.

ul.li: Fast, responsive modern UI built with Qt 6 and QML
Automatic runner detection and in-app Proton-GE / Proton-CachyOS downloader
Isolated Wine prefix management with backup and restore
Virtual Xbox 360 controller emulation via Linux uinput

description.p: Default #d71920 red accent theme and automated AUR release pipeline updates.
First public Arch Linux release of Tsuki Game Launcher.
